name: Variational Inference (VI)
summary: Approximate difficult posteriors through optimization over a tractable probability family.
summary_zh: 选取参数化分布族，通过优化ELBO或散度近似目标后验。
core_idea: Replace direct posterior integration with optimized distributional approximation.
innovation: Can amortize or accelerate uncertainty inference relative to sampling at the cost of approximation bias.
limitations: Variational family can miss multiple modes or underestimate uncertainty.
Optimization of ELBO may be sensitive to parameterization.

start_here.why: Readable peer-reviewed synthesis of variational inference foundations and trade-offs.
start_here.focus: ELBO derivation and comparisons with sampling.

curation_note: Representative primary or authoritative scholarly source has been checked; the suggested starting reference is optional, not a required reading quota.
